58: /**
59:  * Handles the {@code @UtilityClass} annotation for javac.
60:  */
61: @HandlerPriority(-4096) //-2^12; to ensure @FieldDefaults picks up on the 'static' we set here.
62: @Provides
63: public class HandleUtilityClass extends JavacAnnotationHandler<UtilityClass> {
64: 	@Override public void handle(AnnotationValues<UtilityClass> annotation, JCAnnotation ast, JavacNode annotationNode) {
65: 		handleExperimentalFlagUsage(annotationNode, ConfigurationKeys.UTILITY_CLASS_FLAG_USAGE, "@UtilityClass");
66: 		
67: 		deleteAnnotationIfNeccessary(annotationNode, UtilityClass.class);
68: 		
69: 		JavacNode typeNode = annotationNode.up();
70: 		if (!checkLegality(typeNode, annotationNode)) return;
71: 		changeModifiersAndGenerateConstructor(annotationNode.up(), annotationNode);
72: 	}
73: 	
74: 	private static boolean checkLegality(JavacNode typeNode, JavacNode errorNode) {
75: 		if (!isClass(typeNode)) {
76: 			errorNode.addError("@UtilityClass is only supported on a class.");
77: 			return false;
78: 		}
79: 		
80: 		// It might be an inner class. This is okay, but only if it is / can be a static inner class. Thus, all of its parents have to be static inner classes until the top-level.
81: 		JavacNode typeWalk = typeNode;
82: 		while (true) {
83: 			typeWalk = typeWalk.up();
84: 			switch (typeWalk.getKind()) {
85: 			case TYPE:
86: 				JCClassDecl typeDef = (JCClassDecl) typeWalk.get();
87: 				if ((typeDef.mods.flags & (Flags.STATIC | Flags.ANNOTATION | Flags.ENUM | Flags.INTERFACE)) != 0) continue;
88: 				if (typeWalk.up().getKind() == Kind.COMPILATION_UNIT) return true;
89: 				errorNode.addError("@UtilityClass automatically makes the class static, however, this class cannot be made static.");
90: 				return false;
91: 			case COMPILATION_UNIT:
92: 				return true;
93: 			default:
94: 				errorNode.addError("@UtilityClass cannot be placed on a method local or anonymous inner class, or any class nested in such a class.");
95: 				return false;
96: 			}
97: 		}
98: 	}
99: 	
100: 	private void changeModifiersAndGenerateConstructor(JavacNode typeNode, JavacNode errorNode) {
101: 		JCClassDecl classDecl = (JCClassDecl) typeNode.get();
102: 		
103: 		boolean makeConstructor = true;
104: 		
105: 		classDecl.mods.flags |= Flags.FINAL;
106: 		
107: 		boolean markStatic = true;
108: 		
109: 		if (typeNode.up().getKind() == Kind.COMPILATION_UNIT) markStatic = false;
110: 		if (markStatic && typeNode.up().getKind() == Kind.TYPE) {
111: 			JCClassDecl typeDecl = (JCClassDecl) typeNode.up().get();
112: 			if ((typeDecl.mods.flags & (Flags.INTERFACE | Flags.ANNOTATION)) != 0) markStatic = false;
113: 		}
114: 		
115: 		if (markStatic) classDecl.mods.flags |= Flags.STATIC;
116: 		
117: 		for (JavacNode element : typeNode.down()) {
118: 			if (element.getKind() == Kind.FIELD) {
119: 				JCVariableDecl fieldDecl = (JCVariableDecl) element.get();
120: 				fieldDecl.mods.flags |= Flags.STATIC;
121: 			} else if (element.getKind() == Kind.METHOD) {
122: 				JCMethodDecl methodDecl = (JCMethodDecl) element.get();
123: 				if (methodDecl.name.contentEquals("<init>")) {
124: 					if (getGeneratedBy(methodDecl) == null && (methodDecl.mods.flags & Flags.GENERATEDCONSTR) == 0) {
125: 						element.addError("@UtilityClasses cannot have declared constructors.");
126: 						makeConstructor = false;
127: 						continue;
128: 					}
129: 				}
130: 				
131: 				methodDecl.mods.flags |= Flags.STATIC;
132: 			} else if (element.getKind() == Kind.TYPE) {
133: 				JCClassDecl innerClassDecl = (JCClassDecl) element.get();
134: 				innerClassDecl.mods.flags |= Flags.STATIC;
135: 				ClassSymbol innerClassSymbol = innerClassDecl.sym;
136: 				if (innerClassSymbol != null && innerClassSymbol.type instanceof ClassType) {
137: 					((ClassType) innerClassSymbol.type).setEnclosingType(Type.noType);
138: 				}
139: 			}
140: 		}
141: 		
142: 		if (makeConstructor && findExistingConstructor(typeNode) == MemberExistsResult.EXISTS_BY_USER) {
143: 			makeConstructor = false;
144: 		}
145: 
146: 		if (makeConstructor) createPrivateDefaultConstructor(typeNode);
147: 	}
148: 
149: 	/**
150: 	 * Checks if there is a (non-default) constructor. In case of multiple constructors (overloading), only
151: 	 * the first constructor decides if EXISTS_BY_USER or EXISTS_BY_LOMBOK is returned.
152: 	 *
153: 	 * @param node Any node that represents the Type (JCClassDecl) to look in, or any child node thereof.
154: 	 */
155: 	public static MemberExistsResult constructorExists(JavacNode node) {
156: 		return new HandleUtilityClass().findExistingConstructor(node);
157: 	}
158: 
159: 	private MemberExistsResult findExistingConstructor(JavacNode node) {
160: 		Trees localTrees = this.trees;
161: 		node = upToTypeNode(node);
162: 		if (node == null || node.getAst() == null) return MemberExistsResult.NOT_EXISTS;
163: 
164: 		Context context = node.getContext();
165: 		JCTree astNode = node.get();
166: 		if (!(astNode instanceof JCClassDecl)) return MemberExistsResult.NOT_EXISTS;
167: 
168: 		JCClassDecl classDecl = (JCClassDecl) astNode;
169: 		JCModifiers classMods = classDecl.mods;
170: 		ClassSymbol classSym = classDecl.sym;
171: 		List<JCTree> defs = classDecl.defs;
172: 		Type classType = classSym == null ? null : classSym.type;
173: 		Symbol classOwner = classSym == null ? null : classSym.owner;
174: 
175: 		if (localTrees != null && classSym != null) {
176: 			Tree resolvedTree = localTrees.getTree(classSym);
177: 			if (resolvedTree == null && defs == null) return MemberExistsResult.NOT_EXISTS;
178: 		}
179: 
180: 		String objectName = node.getImportList() == null ? null : node.getImportList().getFullyQualifiedNameForSimpleName("Object");
181: 		if (objectName == null) objectName = "java.lang.Object";
182: 
183: 		boolean annotationType = classMods != null && (classMods.flags & Flags.ANNOTATION) != 0;
184: 		boolean symbolsUsable = context != null && classType != null && classOwner != null && classOwner != classSym;
185: 		if (defs == null) return MemberExistsResult.NOT_EXISTS;
186: 		if (!symbolsUsable && annotationType && defs.isEmpty()) return MemberExistsResult.NOT_EXISTS;
187: 		if (objectName.length() == 0 && defs.isEmpty()) return MemberExistsResult.NOT_EXISTS;
188: 
189: 		for (JCTree def : defs) {
190: 			if (!(def instanceof JCMethodDecl)) continue;
191: 			JCMethodDecl md = (JCMethodDecl) def;
192: 			Name methodName = md.name;
193: 			if (methodName == null || !methodName.contentEquals("<init>")) continue;
194: 
195: 			JCModifiers methodMods = md.mods;
196: 			long methodFlags = methodMods == null ? 0L : methodMods.flags;
197: 			if ((methodFlags & Flags.GENERATEDCONSTR) != 0) continue;
198: 
199: 			boolean hasAnnotations = methodMods != null && methodMods.annotations != null && !methodMods.annotations.isEmpty();
200: 			if (hasAnnotations && isTolerate(node, md)) continue;
201: 
202: 			return getGeneratedBy(def) == null ? MemberExistsResult.EXISTS_BY_USER : MemberExistsResult.EXISTS_BY_LOMBOK;
203: 		}
204: 
205: 		return MemberExistsResult.NOT_EXISTS;
206: 	}
207: 
208: 	private void createPrivateDefaultConstructor(JavacNode typeNode) {
209: 		JavacTreeMaker maker = typeNode.getTreeMaker();
210: 		JCModifiers mods = maker.Modifiers(Flags.PRIVATE, List.<JCAnnotation>nil());
211: 		
212: 		Name name = typeNode.toName("<init>");
213: 		JCBlock block = maker.Block(0L, createThrowStatement(typeNode, maker));
214: 		JCMethodDecl methodDef = maker.MethodDef(mods, name, null, List.<JCTypeParameter>nil(), List.<JCVariableDecl>nil(), List.<JCExpression>nil(), block, null);
215: 		JCMethodDecl constructor = recursiveSetGeneratedBy(methodDef, typeNode);
216: 		JavacHandlerUtil.injectMethod(typeNode, constructor);
217: 	}
218: 	
219: 	private List<JCStatement> createThrowStatement(JavacNode typeNode, JavacTreeMaker maker) {
220: 		JCExpression exceptionType = genJavaLangTypeRef(typeNode, "UnsupportedOperationException");
221: 		List<JCExpression> jceBlank = List.nil();
222: 		JCExpression message = maker.Literal("This is a utility class and cannot be instantiated");
223: 		JCExpression exceptionInstance = maker.NewClass(null, jceBlank, exceptionType, List.of(message), null);
224: 		JCStatement throwStatement = maker.Throw(exceptionInstance);
225: 		return List.of(throwStatement);
226: 	}
227: }

73: 	private static boolean checkLegality(JavacNode typeNode, JavacNode errorNode) {
74: 		if (!isClass(typeNode)) {
75: 			errorNode.addError("@UtilityClass is only supported on a class.");
76: 			return false;
77: 		}
78: 		
79: 		// It might be an inner class. This is okay, but only if it is / can be a static inner class. Thus, all of its parents have to be static inner classes until the top-level.

81: 		while (true) {
82: 			typeWalk = typeWalk.up();
83: 			switch (typeWalk.getKind()) {
84: 			case TYPE:

86: 				if ((typeDef.mods.flags & (Flags.STATIC | Flags.ANNOTATION | Flags.ENUM | Flags.INTERFACE)) != 0) continue;
87: 				if (typeWalk.up().getKind() == Kind.COMPILATION_UNIT) return true;

89: 				return false;
90: 			case COMPILATION_UNIT:
91: 				return true;

97: 	}

101: 		
102: 		boolean makeConstructor = true;
